related.title: NWChem TCE：張量維度、記憶體下界與縮約規劃
related.titleEn: NWChem TCE: tensor dimensions, memory lower bounds and contraction planning
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：不得把單一能帶平均標成 DFT 總能量或材料穩定性結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Do not label this single-band mean as DFT total energy or a material-stability conclusion.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「NWChem TCE：張量維度、記憶體下界與縮約規劃」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付四維張量索引表、兩種容量、分塊所有權與中間量生命期圖。
related.differenceEn: Investigate NWChem TCE: tensor dimensions, memory lower bounds and contraction planning using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver tensor-index definitions, capacities for both virtual spaces, tile ownership and an intermediate-lifetime diagram with separate lower-bound and peak-memory estimates.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以加權式與展開四筆值兩種方式求平均；另算未加權的兩點平均，說明它代表不同問題。
從四百萬元素得到三千二百萬 bytes，再轉 MiB；保留未四捨五入值供配置檢查。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute the result using both weighted arithmetic and the expanded list of four values. Also calculate the unweighted two-point mean and explain why it represents a different sampling measure rather than a competing approximation to the same formula.

Convert four million elements into thirty-two million bytes, then into MiB. Preserve the unrounded value for capacity checks and compare it with decimal MB to show why a label change is not an actual memory saving.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NASA CFD：網格收斂、Richardson 外插與錯誤階數
related.titleEn: NASA CFD: grid convergence, Richardson extrapolation and false-order diagnosis
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：不得把單一能帶平均標成 DFT 總能量或材料穩定性結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Do not label this single-band mean as DFT total energy or a material-stability conclusion.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「NASA CFD：網格收斂、Richardson 外插與錯誤階數」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付三網格差值、觀測階數、外插表與變更組的假設失敗紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Investigate NASA CFD: grid convergence, Richardson extrapolation and false-order diagnosis using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver grid differences, observed orders, extrapolation tables and a recorded assumption failure for the perturbed dataset, separating discretization verification from physical validation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以加權式與展開四筆值兩種方式求平均；另算未加權的兩點平均，說明它代表不同問題。
計算相鄰差 0.12 與 0.03，再以 log2 四取得二；檢查單調性與差值符號。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute the result using both weighted arithmetic and the expanded list of four values. Also calculate the unweighted two-point mean and explain why it represents a different sampling measure rather than a competing approximation to the same formula.
Calculate adjacent differences 0.12 and 0.03, then obtain order two from log2 of four. Check monotonicity and signs before using an order formula that assumes the supplied convergence pattern.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
